record.officialTitle: The Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines (1987)

provisions.heading: Article III, Section 1 — Due Process; Equal Protection
provisions.body: No person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law, nor shall any person be denied the equal protection of the laws.

provisions.heading: Senate — 24 Members
provisions.body: The Senate shall be composed of twenty-four (24) Senators who shall be elected at large by the qualified voters of the Philippines, as may be provided by law.

provisions.heading: President — Term of Six Years
provisions.body: The President and the Vice-President shall be elected by direct vote of the people for a term of six years which shall begin at noon on the thirtieth day of June next following the day of the election and shall end at noon of the same date six years thereafter.

provisions.heading: Right to Health
provisions.body: The State shall protect and promote the right to health of the people and instill health consciousness among them.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 386 — Civil Code of the Philippines

provisions.heading: Article 1156 — Obligation Defined
provisions.body: An obligation is a juridical necessity to give, to do, or not to do.

provisions.heading: Prescriptive periods — 10 years for written contracts
provisions.body: The following actions must be brought within ten (10) years from the time the right of action accrues: (1) Upon a written contract; (2) Upon an obligation arising from law; (3) Upon a judgment.

provisions.heading: Age of Majority — 18
provisions.body: Majority commences upon the attainment of the age of eighteen (18) years, as amended by Republic Act No. 6809.

provisions.heading: Contract — Definition
provisions.body: A contract is a meeting of minds between two persons whereby one binds himself, with respect to the other, to give something or to render some service.

record.officialTitle: Executive Order No. 209 — Family Code of the Philippines

provisions.heading: Article 1 — Marriage Definition
provisions.body: Marriage is a special contract of permanent union between a man and a woman entered into in accordance with law, which is the foundation of the family and an inviolable social institution whose nature, consequences, and incidents are governed by law and not subject to stipulation, except that the marriage settlements may fix the property relations during the marriage within the limits provided by this Code.

provisions.heading: Parental Consent
provisions.body: In case either or both of the contracting parties are between the ages of eighteen and twenty-one, they shall, before the celebration of the marriage, obtain the consent of their parents, whoever may be the parent, in the order provided for in Article 15.

provisions.heading: Requisites of Marriage
provisions.body: No marriage shall be valid, unless these essential requisites are present: (1) Legal capacity of the contracting parties who must be a male and a female; and (2) Consent freely given in the presence of the solemnizing officer.

record.officialTitle: Act No. 3815 — Revised Penal Code of the Philippines

provisions.heading: Murder
provisions.body: Any person who, not falling within the provisions of Article 246, shall kill another with treachery, evident premeditation, or cruelty, or by means of poison, or when the victim is a peace officer or a child, shall be guilty of murder.

provisions.heading: Theft
provisions.body: The taking of personal property of another with intent to gain and without violence against or intimidation of persons is punishable as theft.

provisions.heading: Felonies — Definition
provisions.body: Acts and omissions punishable by law are felonies. Felonies are committed not only by means of deceit (dolo) but also by means of fault (culpa).

record.officialTitle: PD 851 — 13th Month Pay

provisions.heading: 13th Month Pay — 1/12 of Basic Salary
provisions.body: All employers are hereby required to pay their employees a 13th month pay not less than one-twelfth (1/12) of the total basic salary earned by an employee within the calendar year, subject to the rules and regulations issued by the Secretary of Labor.

record.officialTitle: Presidential Decree No. 442 — Labor Code of the Philippines

provisions.heading: Service Incentive Leave — Five Days
provisions.body: Every employee who has rendered at least one year of service shall be entitled to a yearly service incentive leave of five days with pay.

provisions.heading: Non-Diminution of Benefits
provisions.body: Nothing in this Book shall be construed to eliminate or in any way diminish supplements, or other employee benefits being enjoyed at the time of the promulgation of this Code.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 11199 — Social Security Act of 2018

provisions.heading: Social Security System — Administration
provisions.body: The Social Security System is the government agency that shall administer the contributory social security program for private-sector employees; the administration of the program is funded by the monthly contribution prescribed by this Act, which members and their employers shall pay.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 8424 — National Internal Revenue Code, as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN)

provisions.heading: Exemption — P250,000 Threshold
provisions.body: An individual earning purely compensation income whose gross annual income does not exceed Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos (P250,000) shall be exempt from income tax; under the TRAIN law, the exemption threshold is P250,000.

provisions.heading: Graduated Income Tax Rates
provisions.body: The income tax on individuals shall be computed in accordance with the graduated rates under this Section, as amended by Republic Act No. 10963.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 11232 — Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines

provisions.heading: One Person Corporation
provisions.body: A corporation with a single stockholder may be organized as a one person corporation, provided that the sole stockholder, who is also the sole incorporator, is a natural person, trust, or estate.

provisions.heading: Incorporators
provisions.body: Any person, partnership, association, or corporation, singly or jointly with others, but not more than fifteen (15) in number, may organize a corporation for any lawful purpose.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012

provisions.heading: Personal Information Controller
provisions.body: A personal information controller refers to a person or organization who controls the collection, holding, processing, or use of personal information, including one who controls the processing of personal data and instructs another to process personal data on its behalf.

provisions.heading: General Data Privacy Principles
provisions.body: The processing of personal information shall be allowed only if it is for a declared, specified, and legitimate purpose, and the data subject has given consent, or the processing is otherwise authorized by law.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 9184 — Government Procurement Reform Act

provisions.heading: Competitive Bidding
provisions.body: Government procurement shall be done primarily through competitive bidding, except when the use of alternative methods of procurement is justified under the conditions provided in this Act.

record.shortTitle: Occupational Safety and Health Standards Law
record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 11058 — Occupational Safety and Health Standards Law

provisions.heading: Safety Officer — Designation; Safe Workplace
provisions.body: It shall be the duty of every employer to furnish workers a place of employment free from hazardous conditions, to comply with the occupational safety and health standards, and to designate a safety officer in accordance with the rules; the number of employees above which a full-time safety officer is required shall be as provided in the implementing rules and regulations.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 7160 — Local Government Code of 1991

provisions.heading: Term of Office — Three Years
provisions.body: The term of office of elected local officials, such as governors, vice-governors, mayors, vice-mayors, and councilors, shall be three years, which shall begin at noon on the thirtieth day of June next following their election.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 9160 — Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001

provisions.heading: Anti-Money Laundering Council
provisions.body: The Anti-Money Laundering Council is the financial intelligence unit of the Republic of the Philippines, and it receives and analyzes covered and suspicious transaction reports submitted by covered institutions.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 10963 — Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law

provisions.heading: Personal Income Tax — Exemption Threshold
provisions.body: The TRAIN law amended the individual income tax schedule and raised the exemption threshold for individuals earning purely compensation income to P250,000, with the first bracket above the threshold taxed at twenty percent (20%).

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 11223 — Universal Health Care Act

provisions.heading: Mandatory PhilHealth Coverage
provisions.body: All Filipino citizens shall be automatically covered by the National Health Insurance Program administered by the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation, with premiums shared by the member, the employer, and the national government.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 9679 — Home Development Mutual Fund Law of 2009

provisions.heading: Membership — Mandatory Coverage
provisions.body: Membership in the Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag-IBIG Fund) shall be mandatory for all employees covered by the Social Security System and the Government Service Insurance System, with contributions shared equally by employer and employee.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 9298 — Philippine Accountancy Act of 2004

provisions.heading: Practice of Accountancy — Regulation
provisions.body: The practice of accountancy in the Philippines is a profession regulated by the Professional Regulation Commission, and only registered and licensed certified public accountants may practice, as provided by this Act.

record.officialTitle: Republic Act No. 11032 — Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act

provisions.heading: Three-Day Processing of Simple Transactions
provisions.body: Government agencies and local government units shall process simple applications within three (3) working days, complex applications within seven (7) working days, and highly technical applications within twenty (20) working days.

record.officialTitle: Executive Order No. 292 — Administrative Code of 1987

provisions.heading: Administrative Code — Coverage
provisions.body: The Administrative Code of 1987 provides for the structure, powers, and functions of the national government, including the departments, bureaus, and offices of the Executive branch.
